idea-plugin.name: Markdown Review
idea-plugin.description:
Review changes to Markdown files in rendered form, right inside IntelliJ's own diff window, instead of reading raw markup.
  • Rendered side-by-side diff: headings, paragraphs, list items, table rows and code blocks aligned in rows; removed blocks on red, added on green, changed words highlighted.
  • Merged view: one column, removals struck through, additions in green.
  • Text diff one click away in the diff window's viewer switcher.
  • Works for local changes (Commit window), file history, branch comparison and pull requests, plus Compare Markdown Files... for any two files.
  • GitHub Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks, footnotes and alerts.
  • Settings | Tools | Markdown Review picks the viewer a Markdown diff opens with.
Requires an IDE with JCEF (the default in JetBrains Runtime); without it the text diff stays in place.

Free for noncommercial use under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. Commercial use requires a separate license from the author. Source code and issues: github.com/agadek/markdown-review.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • Settings page (Settings | Tools | Markdown Review) and a choice of the default viewer for Markdown diffs.
  • GitHub Flavored Markdown: task lists, strikethrough, autolinks, footnotes and alerts.
  • A link or image whose target changed, and a heading whose level changed, are marked as changed.
  • Relative images resolve against the file; remote images load only when enabled in settings.
  • Very large files show a notice with an Open Text Viewer button instead of rendering; the limit is set in settings.
  • Plugin icon.

0.1.0

  • First version: rendered side-by-side and merged diff viewers for Markdown files.
